rows.note: Use this for the elected law-enforcement head of a US county, including responsibility for the county jail.

example.english: In the US, the sheriff is also responsible for running the county jail.
example.traditional: 美國嘅縣警長仲要負責管理縣監獄。
example.jyutping: mei5 gwok3 ge3 jyun6 ging2 zoeng2 zung6 jiu3 fu6 zaak3 gun2 lei5 jyun6 gaam1 juk6

rows.note: Use this when discussing the British High Sheriff as a formal county office, not the US law-enforcement officer.

example.english: In Britain, the sheriff is responsible for carrying out court orders.
example.traditional: 英國嘅郡長要負責執行法院命令。
example.jyutping: jing1 gwok3 ge3 gwan6 zoeng2 jiu3 fu6 zaak3 zap1 hang4 faat3 jyun2 ming6 ling6
